name: Genmab
description: Genmab is a Copenhagen-based biotech developing antibody cancer medicines and earning royalties on partner drugs like Johnson & Johnson's Darzalex; listed on Nasdaq in Copenhagen and the US.

name: Sunrun
description: Sunrun installs and leases rooftop solar panels and home batteries to US homeowners under long-term lease and power purchase agreements, serving over 1 million customers; listed on Nasdaq.

name: COX Group
description: Cox is a Seville-based water and energy utility that builds and operates desalination, water treatment and renewable power plants for public and industrial clients; listed in Madrid since 2024.

name: SoftBank
description: SoftBank Group is a Tokyo-listed investment holding company with stakes in Arm and OpenAI, investing in technology startups through its Vision Funds and controlling Japanese telecom operator SoftBank Corp.

name: Caris Life Sciences
description: Caris Life Sciences sells AI-supported molecular profiling tests of tumor tissue and blood that help oncologists choose cancer treatments; Nasdaq-listed since June 2025, with $412 million revenue in 2024.

name: Earendil Labs
description: Earendil Labs uses an AI platform to design antibody drugs for immune, inflammatory and cancer diseases, licensing programs to Sanofi and Genentech; it raised $787 million in 2026.

name: Klook
description: Klook runs an online platform where travellers book attraction tickets, tours, transport and hotels, offering over 100,000 experiences in more than 350 destinations, mainly across Asia-Pacific.

name: CG Oncology
description: CG Oncology is a Nasdaq-listed, late-stage biopharmaceutical company developing cretostimogene, an oncolytic immunotherapy delivered into the bladder, for patients with non-muscle invasive bladder cancer.

name: Export Development Canada
description: Export Development Canada is a Crown corporation wholly owned by the Government of Canada that provides trade insurance, financing and bonding to Canadian exporters, investors and their foreign buyers.

name: Silicon Box
description: Silicon Box packages chiplets for chip companies serving AI and high-performance computing, operating a $2 billion factory in Singapore and building a €3.2 billion plant in Novara, Italy.

name: Glencore
description: Glencore mines, processes and trades metals, minerals, coal and oil, supplying industrial customers worldwide; it is listed in London and runs operations in more than 30 countries.

name: PayPal
description: PayPal operates digital payment services including PayPal, Venmo and Braintree for consumers and merchants worldwide, with 439 million active accounts at end-2025 and a Nasdaq listing.

name: Repligen
description: Repligen makes filtration, chromatography and protein products used in manufacturing biologic drugs, selling to biopharmaceutical companies and contract manufacturers; Nasdaq-listed with about 2,000 employees.

name: Bitmine Immersion Technolo
description: BitMine Immersion Technologies is an NYSE American-listed company that buys and stakes ether as a corporate treasury, holding about 5.8 million ETH, and began in bitcoin mining.

name: startkraft
description: Statkraft is a Norwegian state-owned power company producing hydro, wind and solar electricity and trading energy for utilities and businesses, with about 7,000 employees in over 20 countries.

name: Aligned
description: Aligned Data Centers builds and operates data center campuses leased to hyperscale cloud and AI customers, with about 78 data centers operating or under construction across the Americas.
note: Acquired from Macquarie by AI Infrastructure Partnership (BlackRock GIP, MGX) for about $40bn; deal closed 2026.

name: United Overseas Bank
description: UOB is a Singapore-listed bank offering personal, commercial and corporate banking, with more than 470 branches and offices in 19 markets across Asia Pacific, Europe and North America.

name: telMAX
description: telMAX builds a fibre-optic network and sells internet, TV and phone service to homes and businesses in Ontario communities including Markham, Newmarket and Barrie, backed by $215 million in financing.

name: Noon
description: Noon runs an online marketplace plus grocery, food delivery, fashion and payment services for consumers in Saudi Arabia and the UAE, and is backed by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund.

name: Toronto Dominion Bank Group Si
description: TD Bank Group is a Toronto-based bank offering personal, commercial, wealth and wholesale banking in Canada and the US, serving about 28 million customers; listed in Toronto and New York.
note: 2024 US guilty plea over anti-money-laundering failures, about $3bn in penalties and a US asset cap.

name: Nozomi Networks
description: Nozomi Networks sells OT and IoT cybersecurity software that monitors industrial networks for utilities, manufacturers, oil and gas, transport and government operators, with over 12,000 installations worldwide.
note: Mitsubishi Electric announced a deal to acquire it in Sept 2025 (not confirmed in sources checked here).

name: Lumen Technologies
description: Lumen Technologies is an NYSE-listed US telecom operator selling fiber networking, cloud connectivity, security and voice services mainly to enterprise and government customers, with about 25,000 employees.
note: Formerly CenturyLink; sold its Quantum Fiber consumer business to AT&T for $5.75bn (closed Feb 2026).

name: WhiteFiber
description: WhiteFiber provides AI infrastructure, renting GPU cloud capacity and AI-ready colocation from data centers in North Carolina and Montreal to AI developers and enterprises; Nasdaq-listed, majority-owned by Bit Digital.

name: Stag Industrial
description: STAG Industrial is an NYSE-listed REIT that owns and leases warehouses and other industrial properties to business tenants, holding 606 buildings across 41 US states.

name: Digital 9 Infrastructure
description: Digital 9 Infrastructure is a London-listed investment company managed by Triple Point that owns digital infrastructure such as subsea fibre cables, data centres and a stake in Arqiva.
note: In managed wind-down approved by shareholders in 2024; sold Verne Global to Ardian in 2024.

name: Flutterwave
description: Flutterwave provides payment infrastructure, including online checkout, cards, mobile money and remittances, for merchants and payment providers in more than 30 African countries plus the US and Canada.

name: Elm
description: Elm is a Riyadh-based digital services company majority-owned by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, providing e-government, security and business software to Saudi government agencies, companies and individuals; listed on Tadawul.

name: Pie Insurance
description: Pie Insurance sells workers' compensation and other commercial insurance online and through agents to US small businesses, writing workers' comp in 39 states plus Washington, DC.

name: Geely Auto
description: Geely Automobile Holdings is a Hong Kong-listed Chinese carmaker selling petrol and electric cars under Geely, Galaxy, Zeekr and Lynk & Co brands, with 2.18 million vehicles sold in 2024.

name: Fairfax Financial Holdings
description: Fairfax Financial is a Toronto-listed holding company that owns property and casualty insurers and reinsurers worldwide, including Allied World, Odyssey and Brit, with about $33.6 billion revenue in 2025.

name: Realty Income
description: Realty Income is an NYSE-listed REIT that owns over 15,000 commercial properties in the US and Europe, leased long-term to tenants such as Dollar General, Walgreens and 7-Eleven.

name: McDonald's
description: McDonald's is an NYSE-listed fast-food chain serving burgers, fries and drinks to consumers through 45,356 restaurants in more than 100 countries, about 95% run by franchisees.

name: Altruist
description: Altruist is a digital custodian and wealth platform for independent registered investment advisers, combining account opening, trading, portfolio management, billing, reporting and AI tools in one system.

name: Atlas Energy Solutions
description: Atlas Energy Solutions supplies frac sand and logistics, including its Dune Express conveyor, to oil and gas producers in the Permian Basin, and makes gas-fired power generators; NYSE-listed.

name: Perpetua
description: Perpetua Resources is developing the Stibnite gold-antimony mine in Idaho, aiming to supply gold and a domestic US antimony source for defense and industry; listed on Nasdaq and TSX.

name: Cruise
description: Cruise is a former General Motors self-driving subsidiary that ran driverless robotaxi services in San Francisco and other US cities; its technology now feeds GM's driver-assistance systems.
note: GM ended robotaxi funding Dec 2024; Cruise merged into GM Feb 2025.

name: VERBUND
description: Verbund is Austria's largest electricity company, generating mostly hydropower and selling power to households, businesses and traders in Austria, Germany and beyond; 51% state-owned and listed in Vienna.

name: Renalfa IPP
description: Renalfa IPP is a Vienna-based power producer owning and developing solar, wind and battery storage plants in Bulgaria, Hungary, North Macedonia and Romania, with over 800 MW operating.

name: Factorial
description: Factorial sells cloud HR software for time tracking, payroll, leave, recruiting and performance reviews to small and mid-sized businesses, with over 16,000 customers in more than 90 countries.

name: LG Energy Solution
description: LG Energy Solution makes lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles and energy storage, supplying automakers such as GM, Tesla, Toyota and Mercedes-Benz; Korea Exchange-listed and about 81% owned by LG Chem.

name: Bloom Energy
description: Bloom Energy makes solid oxide fuel cell systems that generate on-site electricity for data centers, utilities, hospitals and factories, with about 1.4 GW installed at over 1,000 sites; NYSE-listed.

name: Creafin
description: Creafin is an independent Belgian mortgage lender that finances homes and property investments for individuals and companies through about 650 independent credit brokers, and offers mortgage portfolios to institutional investors.

name: Rezolute
description: Rezolute is a Nasdaq-listed biotech developing ersodetug, an antibody treatment for congenital and tumor hyperinsulinism, rare conditions causing dangerously low blood sugar, with two Phase 3 programs.

name: BHG Financial
description: BHG Financial provides personal loans up to $250,000 and business loans up to $500,000 to high-earning professionals, including healthcare professionals, and has funded over $33 billion in loans.

name: Agricultural Bank of China
description: Agricultural Bank of China is a largely state-owned bank listed in Shanghai and Hong Kong, serving about 320 million retail and 2.7 million corporate customers through nearly 24,000 branches.

name: Capital Power
description: Capital Power is a TSX-listed independent power producer operating 29 natural gas, wind and solar plants that sell electricity in Alberta, British Columbia, Ontario and 11 US states.

name: Ce
description: Cecabank is a Madrid-based wholesale bank providing securities custody and depositary, treasury, payments and banking technology services to banks and financial institutions in Spain, with branches in Portugal and Luxembourg.

name: Telesat
description: Telesat is an Ottawa-based satellite operator, listed on Nasdaq and TSX, selling broadcast, broadband and backhaul capacity to TV providers, telecoms and governments while building its Lightspeed low-orbit constellation.

name: Commonwealth Bank of Aust
description: Commonwealth Bank of Australia is an ASX-listed bank offering retail, business and institutional banking, wealth and broking services to about 17.6 million customers, mainly in Australia and New Zealand.

name: Antares
description: Antares Nuclear develops factory-built, transportable fission microreactors producing 100 kW to 1 MW of electricity for military and other defense-critical sites, and ran its first reactor demonstration in 2026.
